GraceDeployment.Target: Static HTML output rendered from this repository into html/aicc, mirrored by the aicc-deploy tool into the clean deployment repository /devops/websvc/websvc-ob-aicc (folder html/aicc), then pushed to its origin (GitHub) and websvc remotes; the websvc push triggers a server hook and Caddy serves the result
GraceDeployment.Notes: The maintained portal build writes one language-first layout: html/aicc/index.html forwards to en/; html/aicc/{en,ru}/index.html is the router of each language with one door per branch; html/aicc/404.html is the one self-contained page for a missing address, linking the routers at /aicc/en/ and /aicc/ru/. The five branches are center/ (the charter pages built by portal/tools/build.py), discovery/ (portal/tools/discovery.py from portfolio/{en,ru}/discovery/), portfolio/ (portal/tools/portfolio.py: the Portfolio Kanban, register, review and an ini-*/ summary per Initiative), program/ (portal/tools/delivery.py: the Program Kanban and items/; portal/tools/project.py: the service-resolution/ documents from portfolio/{en,ru}/projects/service-resolution/) and lab/ (portal/tools/lab.py from lab/{en,ru}/lab.md). The routes are a clean break: no former route and no redirect stub is published. Every branch has its own search index, assets/search-{branch}-{lang}.json, and every page can also search all of them. Freshness checks rebuild the whole layout; page content, text, diagrams, reading assets and search are bundled locally with no runtime dependency on retired sources. Publication refreshes the progress views and does not change business state or expose closed evidence. Deployment and portable export consume this complete output; the 404 page takes effect only where the web server is configured to serve it.

Internal URL http://hetzner-cx43.alpines-krait.ts.net/aicc/ and external URL https://aicc.hejihogusei.link/ behind Cloudflare Access; the allow-list was checked by the practitioner on 2026-09-29 and contains only the practitioner. Server side is owned by websvc-infra. Publishing is a deliberate act: aicc-deploy defaults to a dry run and pushes only with --publish. See deploy/README.md. A separate on-demand command, python3 portal/tools/export_portable.py, packages the generated website into portal/published for direct-file browsing from a copied folder or corporate share. Open aicc.html. Adding --static creates complete standalone portal/published/en and portal/published/ru editions, each with its own index.html and local assets, no JavaScript, light-only styling, native disclosures, topic links, visible view sections, inline source workflow descriptions and full-diagram files. Each language folder can be copied separately. This export is never refreshed automatically and does not publish the website; see portal/PORTABLE.md.
